**This is a collection of the resources I've found helpful during my undergraduate studies.** As a Statistics major in the Philippines, people would occassionally think of us as *"endangered species"* due to the traditionally low number of enrollees. This made academic support extra challenging since there's low number of people who understand my concern. So I searched stuff online and found these; I think these are helpful if you also:

*1. HATES proving theorems and find applied statistics more enjoyable;*
*2. Comes from a developing nation who doesn't have all the time to learn huge books due to poor internet connection, frequent power outage, etc and;*
*3. Cares about reproducibility in science and valid inference so are considering making your own package!*

If you have other questions about my experience as a Statistics student, being a maintainer of packages, CRAN submissions, and literally anything that would convince you to take Stat, just email me at ninotalingting77@gmail.com. Don't forget to test your assumptions and map your residuals!
